root_keys.name: orders
root_keys.note: Every ORDER_CODE in orders.xlsx must appear exactly once. Coverage violations are scored as constraint failures.

fields.name: ORDER_CODE
fields.note: Must match a code in orders.xlsx; used for coverage, JSJ check, C9 deadline, and C10 套 grouping. Accessed via o.get("ORDER_CODE") — None if absent, causing coverage miss.

fields.name: MATERIAL_CODE
fields.note: Accessed as o["MATERIAL_CODE"] (bracket, not .get) on line 334 inside the shipped-order guard. KeyError if a non-delayed order omits this field. Delayed orders never reach that branch.

fields.name: QTY
fields.note: Order quantity from source data; not decided by agent. Read as o.get("QTY", 0) for C3 daily-limit and C6 inventory-balance checks. Defaults to 0 if absent.

fields.name: is_delayed
fields.note: true = order is delayed (ship_date and warehouse should be null/omitted). false (default) = order ships. Controls whether an order appears in `shipped` list and objective delayed_count.

fields.name: ship_date
fields.note: Must be a valid send_date in the planning window (C1). Must be <= order deadline (C9). Null / absent for delayed orders.

fields.name: warehouse
fields.note: Name of the shipping warehouse. JSJ orders must use an external warehouse (外租库) (C2). Daily throughput per warehouse is capped by limit_num_day (C3). Null / absent for delayed orders.

root_keys.name: transfers
root_keys.note: Optional. Defaults to [] if the key is absent. May be an empty list if the plan needs no inter-warehouse transfers.

fields.name: machine_id
fields.note: Material/machine type being transferred. Used in C5 (batch count per machine_id <= db_limit) and C8 (禁调品名 types must never be transferred). Also used as the material axis in inventory-conservation bookkeeping (C6/C7).

fields.name: from_warehouse
fields.note: Source warehouse. Must be a factory warehouse (工厂库) — C4.

fields.name: to_warehouse
fields.note: Destination warehouse. Must be an external warehouse (外租库) — C4.

fields.name: qty
fields.note: Quantity transferred. Read as t.get("qty", 0). Used in inventory-balance simulation (C6/C7) and transfer_cost formula (wms: qty/2, aps: qty).

fields.name: transfer_type
fields.note: "wms" or "aps". Determines cost weight: wms transfers cost qty/2, aps transfers cost qty. No other values are recognised.

fields.name: trigger_date
fields.note: Date the transfer is executed. Must be a valid date in day_idx (the send_date planning window). If not found in day_idx the transfer is silently skipped in inventory simulation, so an invalid date effectively removes the transfer from scoring.
